title: Explicit F1-F2 equivalences for the Li-Kaleyski dimension-15 matches
summary: Give explicit EA or CCZ maps realizing every computationally detected equivalence between the Li-Kaleyski families and F1-F2 in dimension 15.

formal_statement.body: For each $i\in\{1,2,3,4\}$ at $m=5$ ($n=15$), pair the source Theorem 1 member at parameter $i$ with the Theorem 9 member at parameter $5-i$. For the corresponding member $G$ of family F1-F2, exhibit affine permutations $A,B$ and an affine map $L$ such that $G=A\circ F\circ B+L$, or give an equivalent explicit CCZ map on the graph. Verify all four paired instances.

scope.domain: Explicit EA and CCZ equivalence witnesses for the source's dimension-15 APN matches
assumptions: The source-reported matches and target F1-F2 members are those of Section V-B and Table V
For quadratic APN functions, the source uses the equivalence between CCZ- and EA-equivalence
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source's code test establishes equivalence decisions but does not publish the affine maps. A later theorem proves equivalence between the source's two new families themselves, not explicit maps from the matched dimension-15 cases to F1-F2.
